components.title: Lily Pond
components.brief:
Lily Pond

Slug: `pixel-lily-pond`.

Composition: A shallow, irregular pond cut into a thick grassy tile. A broad lily pad cluster occupies one bank, a single oversized lotus flower supplies a vertical silhouette, and three blunt stepping stones reveal the water's scale. One large fish is visible beneath the open water. Use a clean water plane and a short bank edge rather than noisy dither. The open swimming area should cover at least half the pond so the fish never competes with vegetation.

Motion: The fish slowly follows one closed route around the lily pads. Its body turns along the path and its tail makes a restrained stroke. A short two mark wake belongs to the moving fish and fades directly behind it. No independent ambient ripples or floating debris.

Preset Crescent: A crescent of water curves around a raised grassy peninsula. The fish follows a long return route around its rounded end, with vegetation concentrated at the two narrow tips.

Elliott Bay Ferry Pier

**Slug:** `elliott-bay-ferry-pier`

Rotary Assembly

**Slug:** `rotary-assembly`

Canal Lock

**Slug:** `canal-lock`

**Place and composition:** A single lock chamber sits between a short upper canal basin and a short lower basin. Thick masonry side walls expose the difference in water height. Ridge Cableway

**Slug:** `ridge-cableway`
